sonnet.problem: Story card 5 already says the king will give the fields to 'his servants'. The right answer on this card is 'His officials and servants', and the wrong answers are priests and Levites and the poor and widows. The earlier card hands the baker the answer.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The statement says 'in the end' the people will become the king's slaves. Verse 17 gives no time like that. It only says 'you yourselves will become his slaves', after the list of what the king will take.
sonnet.rule: Times stay true. No time in the text means none added.
